answer_1.quote: The task of code completion using a language model M can be generally described as Ŷ = M(X), where Ŷ represents the predicted tokens and X corresponds to the in-file unfinished code.

answer_2.quote: Following established practices in code completion research, we evaluate our line and API completion datasets using two metrics: Exact Match (EM) and Edit Similarity (ES).
